description: Source code for LoRaWAN integration in Zephyr OS, including initialization, join procedures, message sending, and callback handling.

methods.name: BoardGetUniqueId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique ID of the board (stub implementation).

methods.name: get_battery_level
methods.description: Returns the current battery level via callback or default value.

methods.name: mac_process_notify
methods.description: Notifies the MAC layer to process pending events.

methods.name: datarate_observe
methods.description: Checks and updates the current data rate, calls callback if changed.

methods.name: mcps_confirm_handler
methods.description: Handles MCPS confirmation events from the MAC layer.

methods.name: mcps_indication_handler
methods.description: Handles MCPS indication events, including downlink messages.

methods.name: mlme_confirm_handler
methods.description: Handles MLME confirmation events, such as join responses.

methods.name: mlme_indication_handler
methods.description: Handles MLME indication events.

methods.name: lorawan_join_otaa
methods.description: Performs OTAA join procedure with provided configuration.

methods.name: lorawan_join_abp
methods.description: Performs ABP join procedure with provided configuration.

methods.name: lorawan_set_region
methods.description: Sets the LoRaWAN region based on input parameter.

methods.name: lorawan_join
methods.description: Main function to join a LoRaWAN network (OTAA or ABP).

methods.name: lorawan_set_class
methods.description: Sets the device class (A, C).

methods.name: lorawan_set_datarate
methods.description: Sets the data rate if ADR is disabled.

methods.name: lorawan_get_payload_sizes
methods.description: Retrieves maximum payload sizes.

methods.name: lorawan_get_min_datarate
methods.description: Gets the minimum supported data rate.

methods.name: lorawan_enable_adr
methods.description: Enables or disables Adaptive Data Rate.

methods.name: lorawan_set_conf_msg_tries
methods.description: Sets the number of message retransmission tries.

methods.name: lorawan_send
methods.description: Sends a LoRaWAN message with specified port, data, and type.

methods.name: lorawan_register_battery_level_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for battery level updates.

methods.name: lorawan_register_downlink_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for downlink message handling.

methods.name: lorawan_register_dr_changed_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for data rate change events.

methods.name: lorawan_start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the LoRaWAN stack.

methods.name: lorawan_init
methods.description: Performs internal initialization of LoRaWAN subsystem.
